title: Perplexity AI vs Google Search
full_monologue: **Perplexity AI is changing how we search forever.** Unlike Google, it understands context, delivers precise answers, and even writes code. It’s like having a genius in your pocket. Imagine typing a question and getting a full explanation, not just a link. It’s faster, smarter, and more intuitive. And with its ability to generate content on the fly, it’s outpacing traditional search engines. So, is Google’s reign over? Let me know in the comments.
